question: What rejuvenating transformation occurs even in an old person after six months of repeated practice?
premises: The practice is performed repeatedly for six months.
Age does not prevent the result.
inference: Through six months of repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
uncertainties: asevanā and taruṇā show sandhi-related surface forms.
plain_english: Through six months of repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
